pages.text: Villagers here are people, not vending machines. $(bold)Villager Comfort$(): a villager without a bed, light and food trades badly; a happy village trades well.$(br2)$(bold)Restock Balance$(): trades run out and restock slowly. Buying out one librarian all day does not work.

Together they make trading halls pointless and towns valuable: the best prices are in a real village with real beds, and the way to more trade is $(bold)more villages$(), not more cells.$(br2)$(bold)Create Better Villagers$() gives them Create goods to sell and buy. Villager trades are also how Blueprints spread once towns learn them.

$(bold)Workers$() (Villager Workers): hire a farmer, miner, lumberjack, fisherman or shepherd with emeralds. Give them a chest, a bed and food and they work the area you set. They are the first labour you can buy.$(br2)Press the keys they tell you on hire; their own wiki is in the mod's screen.
